metadata.title: Creating An Asset Isn't One Generic Template.
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: when Claude 'creates an asset,' is that a generic template it invents on its own, or something built from your specific deal? Lands the carry-out that the skill drafts four different sales formats, each shaped by your prospect, audience, and goal.

beats.narration_text: Someone assumes this skill just designs a deck from nothing. It doesn't — it generates one of four sales asset types from your actual deal: landing pages, decks, one-pagers, workflow demos.

beats.act: 1 anatomy — a skill is a folder
beats.narration_text: This kind of asset-building runs on something called a skill — a folder Claude reads before it works. Inside are three files: a README, a quick reference, and the SKILL.md that spells out the process. Claude reads it, then follows it. The file is the whole program.

shot.new_visual_element: A folder icon opening to reveal SKILL.md, README.md, QUICKREF.md; SKILL.md highlighted

production_viz.label: A skill is a folder
production_viz.mechanic: A folder opens on cream to reveal three items: SKILL.md (highlighted in crimson), README.md, QUICKREF.md. A caption below reads 'Claude reads it, then follows it.'

beats.narration_text: The steps run in order: read the file, work through each step exactly as written — gather your deal context, generate the asset, then return it ready to share. Nothing runs out of sequence unless a step itself says so.

shot.new_visual_element: Three-phase pipeline: Read SKILL.md -> Gather context + generate -> Return asset

production_viz.label: Input in, output shaped by your deal
production_viz.mechanic: Three cards left to right joined by arrows: 'Read SKILL.md', 'Gather context + generate', 'Return asset'. Linear, no branch points drawn.

beats.narration_text: For this skill, there are exactly four asset types it covers: landing pages, decks, one-pagers, and workflow demos — each one shaped by your deal context, not invented from scratch: your prospect, your audience, your goal. Ask for a fifth kind of asset and there's no format that covers it.

shot.new_visual_element: Four format rows: landing page, deck, one-pager, workflow demo; a boundary line with 'nothing outside this list' beyond it

production_viz.label: Exactly four formats
production_viz.mechanic: Four rows fill in one at a time with a checkmark: 'Landing page — for a link to share', 'Deck — for a live pitch', 'One-pager — for a leave-behind', 'Workflow demo — for a working preview'. A dashed boundary line beneath the list, with a faint unlabelled field beyond it captioned 'nothing outside this list'. Below the list, a second line reads 'shaped by: prospect, audience, goal'.

beats.narration_text: Create-an-asset doesn't invent a generic deck from nothing — it builds one of four sales formats, shaped by your actual deal: your prospect, your audience, your goal.

props.sparkLine: Built from your deal, not from nothing.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Here's the prompt — read it with me. Ask Claude: I'm pitching my landscaping business to a property manager who cares most about reliability and price. Write me a one-page sales asset: a headline, three bullets on why we fit their goal, and one call to action — built for that prospect, not a generic template. Liam, in for Bear.
